name: Aliva
facts: Vast green masterplan; pure engagement concept. — Lagoon Beach Park, River Park, Fields Park, Home Park (Farmer's Market), Club Park.

name: SouthMed
facts: World-class sustainable coastal masterplan on 23 million sqm. — International Marina (rivals Amalfi), 8km pristine swimmable beach, Crystal Lagoons, 18-hole golf course, Luxury Spa, Hotels, Open-air mall.

name: Badya
facts: Egypt's first cognitive smart city. — Smart home technology, vast recreational areas, eco-friendly infrastructure, dedicated downtown, expansive sports facilities.

name: IL Bosco
facts: Features the iconic 'Vertical Forest'. — Vertical Forest (buildings integrated with greenery), The Creek (river-like water feature), Community Center, Sports Club, Commercial strip, The Cliff villas.

name: ZED East
facts: 80% allocated to greenery, parks, and landscapes. — ZED Club, ZED East University, 29.4k sqm retail area, 137k sqm offices, massive central plazas.

name: O West
facts: Divided into 4 neighborhoods: Spring Valley, Parkside, Club Yard, Hillside. — O West Sports Club, Downtown commercial hub, 4 International Schools, Art Center, Hospital.

name: Vinci
unit_types: Apartments, Twin Houses, Townhouses, Villas, Serviced Apts
facts: Divided into 8 art-inspired luxury districts. — 5km lake promenade, walkery pathways, community center, boutique commercial strip, signature clubhouses.

name: Villette
facts: Houses make up just a third of the area; walkable green spaces. — 4 signature pocket parks (52,000 sqm total), Club S Villette (30-acre sports club), town center, 8-meter min distance between units.

name: VYE
facts: Contemporary European style with glass facades. — VYE Business District, VYE Town Center, electronic security, artificial lakes, solar panel integration, Central Gardens.

name: Madinaty
facts: Massive self-sustaining city housing 700,000 residents. — Madinaty Sporting Club (200 acres), South Park, Open Air Mall, Craft Zone, international schools, 18 mosques, central cooling, smart security.

name: Haptown
facts: 1,021,902 sqm land area designed by CallisonRTKL & Alchemy. — Sports Club, 24,000 sqm commercial district, 49,000 sqm office spaces, 7.5km of bicycle trails.

name: District 5
facts: Divided into 5 distinct experiences: Live, Play, Grow, Shop, Work. — Massive open-air commercial mall, Business Park, Lifestyle center, Club 5, walking trails.

name: Noor Capital Gardens
facts: Eco-friendly, 15-minute smart city prioritizing sustainability. — Solar panels, smart climate control, waste management recycling, TMG mega-club, commercial strip, schools.

name: Mivida
facts: 222 acres of eco-friendly pine forests and native greenery. — Mivida Business Park, Boulevard retail area, international schools (Repton, EISC), Mivida Healthcare city, Clubhouses.

name: Eastown
facts: Urban, walkable design with an 8km green spine. — Eastown District New Cairo (EDNC) commercial hub, clubhouses, pedestrian tree-lined promenades, retail spine.

name: Cairo Festival City
facts: Egypt's premier mixed-use destination. — CFC Mall (largest in East Cairo), IKEA, KidZania, AIS School, Honda Academy, massive Business Park.

name: Mountain View Hyde Park
unit_types: iVillas, Apartments, Twin Houses, Standalone Villas
facts: Signature American-style architecture with blue roofs. — Sunken gardens, majestic lake, 2km pedestrian promenade, Club Park, commercial strip.

name: Taj City
facts: Sprawling masterplan segmented into boutique zones (Origami, Club Side, Elect). — Taj City Club, Business District, international schools, medical center, vast open parks.

name: Hyde Park New Cairo
facts: Features the largest private park in Egypt (141 acres). — Hyde Park Club, Hyde Out (F&B/Entertainment), Business District, international schools, medical center.

name: The Waterway
facts: Boutique, highly dense commercial-residential integration. — The Waterway commercial strip (premium F&B), office spaces, hotel-serviced apartments, underground parking.

name: Palm Hills October
facts: Vast, undulating landscape emphasizing privacy. — Palm Hills Club (27 holes golf course), commercial hubs, schools, equestrian facilities.

name: Sarai
facts: Built around Cairo's largest private crystal lagoon. — Equestrian club, athletic club, luxury hotel, commercial mall, education hub, lagoon beaches.

name: Al Burouj
facts: Fully integrated community with 70 acres dedicated to an orchard park. — Cadmus International School, Smart Village East, Al Burouj Cultural Hub (El Sawy Culturewheel), massive sports club.

name: IL Monte Galala
facts: Mountain resort built on varying elevations up to 210m above sea level. — First crystal lagoon in the mountains, Basecamp, Maesta Promenade, luxury hotels, marina access.

name: Marassi
facts: Mediterranean-inspired coastal city encompassing 5 beaches. — International Marina, 18-hole golf course, 9 luxury hotels, Mporium commercial hub, exclusive clubhouses.
